known_limitations: Template-grammar candidate generation covers four topology families (local, local+independent-verify, isolated-child, branching); it cannot yet synthesize novel families beyond the grammar.
Predicted-value components are deterministic template economics, not learned estimates; calibration against observed value has no live-execution data yet.
Prediction-hash integrity is enforced only when the runtime record carries the frozen hash; runtime records are trusted per instrumentation assumption A1 (flagged by the independent verifier).
Historical replay checks principle-presence compatibility against five frozen cases; it does not re-execute historical topologies.
The gate consumes serialized verification inputs without cryptographic provenance authentication (documented assumption); input integrity rests on the append-only chains and process discipline.
Distinction features (requires_isolation, locally_resolvable, ...) are supplied by the task packaging; latent-feature discovery from raw task semantics is untested.
recommended_next_experiment: Latent multi-role topology-discovery study: a blinded task bank where the need for independence, counterexample search, alternative decomposition, specialized verification, or no child is hidden in task semantics (not stated in evidence requirements). Score topology correctness, prediction calibration (predicted vs observed utility per component), observed utility, counterfactual regret against shadow topologies, and formal governance.
